question: Is the incumbent's DE3 iron amplification q=0.5 and its three-seed average at a local optimum, measured on the recorded out-of-fold predictions?
incumbent_form: iron = V12_iron + q * (mean(3 seeds) - V12_iron), incumbent uses q = 0.5
limits: Two split seeds only; the four-complete-seed promotion gate is not met by this review.
The labels are the round-two training targets, already used by the recorded run; this is a re-measurement of recorded predictions, not a new holdout.
The amplification grid is one-dimensional and was chosen before running; no platform score may be forecast from it.
The q=1.0 endpoint is inside the earlier independently verified conditional platform bound over q in [0.5, 1.0] (EVIDENCE_STATUS.iron_strength_bound_20261004).
